builder.query: $song .song, song.land=$land, song.theme=$theme; $land .theme_design, doc.title=$name, doc.body=$brief, music_design.instruments=$instruments, music_design.motif=$motif, music_design.voice=$voice

content.body:
Create a full-length fantasy game soundtrack song for $name.

Land brief: $brief
This song’s theme: $theme
Feature these instruments: $instruments.
Return to this melodic motif throughout the song: $motif
Voice direction: $voice. For none, purely instrumental throughout: no human voice, humming, vocal pads, choir, singing, speech or chanting. For solo, one distant solo wordless voice may carry a phrase, no choir. For choir, wordless choir voices may carry the melody. Never lyrics, chanting, speech or spoken words.
Make a distinct and complete song with a memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. Use clean, natural acoustic production without distortion, lo-fi filtering or electronic effects. Produce one audio artifact in slot main.
